community.title: Gamepad in menus
community.notes: +set in_useJoystick 1 makes the engine read the controller: without it the menus ignore the DualSense (the saved profile has in_useJoystick 0). Needs a Playden newer than 0.12.0-beta.5 with leolobato/playden-ps5#1336 (CPU ~MHz registry keys); older builds crash at start with a division by zero. Tested up to the main menu and Settings only, not gameplay.
community.author: argrento
